batch_node.name: Gridkin fixture — OCC update
batch_node.description: Replaces the OCC Demo Node with envelope-declared entity_expected_version=1. The seed fixture's create lands the entity at version=1 (a single logical create operation produces one version state). This fixture's replace must observe version=1 and bump to 2. If the OCC machinery regresses (version check skipped, declared-on-missing rule broken, etc.) this fixture fails to import and the scenario fails before the query runs.

node.name: OCC Demo Node
node.description: Updated description; OCC matched on entity_expected_version=1.
